title: Episode 4
summary: An elderly churchgoer is found dead in a church while it was locked.
method: The victim was bludgeoned with a wooden box and the scene was staged as a fall. The killer locked the door with a spare key and put a coin in the lock to make it look like it was locked on the inside. During the commotion, she unlocked the door, then during the commotion, put the key in the lock when she was back inside and put the coin in the collection box.
motive: The victim wanted to return a valuable painting instead of helping the school financially. The school was heavily in debt.
